commit.subject: LU-21062 libcfs: Add BUG() after calling lbug_with_loc()
commit.message:
LU-21062 libcfs: Add BUG() after calling lbug_with_loc()

Since Linux 6.5 lbug_with_loc() is not in objtool's noreturn list,
so it is declared without __noreturn, but objtool finds that it never
returns and reports "missing __noreturn" warnings, which fail the
build with CONFIG_OBJTOOL_WERROR=y.

Add BUG() after lbug_with_loc() in LBUG() and LASSERTF() on newer
kernels: objtool accepts a UD2 after a call it knows never returns.
lbug_with_loc() is declared with __noreturn on older kernels, so
nothing is added.

Fixes: 9f44a48b3659 ("LU-17793 libcfs: fix objtool warning in lbug_with_loc()")
Signed-off-by: Xiao Yang <xyang@ddn.com>
Change-Id: I92cba012283d14fc9a9727a7eb1a6d2923abd514
